job_description: The Clinical Educator (NP) supports clinical quality and education for Nurse Practitioners and physicians delivering care on the Hims & Hers platform. They also work to scale manual processes (such as automating coaching interventions or standardizing provider guidance) to keep pace with provider growth alongside Hims & Hers. Clinical Educators collaborate closely with Clinical Leadership, Training & Content, and other cross-functional partners to enhance education programs, strengthen clinical quality, and optimize the overall provider experience.
